title: 第015章 针锋相对第016章 谁是笑话
content_zh:
第015章针锋相对
陈默对着蒋瑶妈妈微笑拱手：“祝阿姨生意兴隆，财源滚滚！”
蒋瑶父母都是老实巴交的实在人，听到陈默的贺词，蒋瑶妈妈顿时眉开眼笑，看着陈默双眼放光：“小默同学真会说话，难怪我家瑶瑶成天念叨，不错不错，看来瑶瑶这孩子很有眼光嘛！”
蒋瑶在一旁急的直跺脚，本就极度自卑的她，脸都红到脖子根了，当着这么多同学的面，被老妈这么调侃，以后去了学校，哪还有脸见人啊？
“老妈，你快去忙，快去，我同学都等急了！”
说着，蒋瑶推着她老妈进了后厨。
陈默本想说完贺词，就把红包送上，可蒋瑶老妈被蒋瑶轰走，这下陈默不知道该怎么办了。
如果送给蒋瑶，这小妮子肯定不会收，于是，陈默趁人不注意，悄悄把红包丢在收款台的桌子上，然后若无其事的站在原地。
蒋瑶把老妈推走，这才转身，不好意思的看了眼陈默，指着尚未坐满的两张大圆桌说道：“陈默，都是咱们班的同学，你看坐哪一桌？”
“陈默，坐这里！”那天在考场提醒陈默的胖子赵刚，热情喊道。
“好！”陈默微笑走过去，坐下和几个前世比较要好的同学，聊了起来。
看着陈默落座，蒋瑶放下心来，冲着同学们微笑道：“大家先聊着，我去看看菜好了没有？”
“瑶瑶你别忙活了，都是同学，客气啥，你赶紧找个位置坐下，大家伙都等着和你说话呢！”一个男生冲蒋瑶喊道，顿时，吸引了大部分同学的目光。
陈默看了过去，这个男生他记得，王磊，很有组织能力，是高中时期，那些普通学生中的代表人物。
“对对，瑶瑶你快坐下，你不在我们聊着也没劲！”一个脸上长着青春痘的女生，拉着蒋瑶说道。
其他同学也是一阵起哄，要求蒋瑶坐下。
陈默没有说话，但却微笑着看向蒋瑶，也是希望她能坐下来陪大家聊天，毕竟她才是这次聚会的发起者。
看到大家极力邀请，蒋瑶只好答应：“好，那我就坐下来陪大家说说话。”
现场有两桌，每一桌都有两三个空位，大家都嚷嚷着请蒋瑶来他们那一桌。
蒋瑶的目光在两桌之间扫了扫，微不可查的在陈默身上停留了一瞬。

陈默身边细心的赵刚立刻捕捉到，嘴角一弯，赶忙起身说道：“瑶瑶，你坐我这吧，这个位置在中间，正好两桌的同学都能兼顾，我坐前面那个空位置就行。”
说完，还冲着陈默挑了挑眉毛，一副‘你小子欠哥们一个人情’的模样。
陈默哑然失笑，无奈的摇摇头，对赵刚的好意，只能心领。
其他也想要邀请蒋瑶的男生，顿时脸色难看，暗骂赵刚滑头，偏偏找的借口又是那么冠冕堂皇，让人无从反驳。
蒋瑶正想跟陈默坐一起，但又不好明说，见到赵刚让位，又找了这么好一个理由，自然十分欣喜：“好啊，谢谢赵刚！”
看着蒋瑶坐在陈默身边，还靠的那么近，一些对蒋瑶有想法的男生顿时不乐意了。
两名男生暗暗对视一眼，轻轻点头，然后其中一名男生故作随意的问道：“对了周豪，今天是蒋瑶家餐馆开业的日子，你准备了什么贺礼？”
留着偏分头的周豪，立刻挺起胸膛，有些得意指着门口那盆发财树：“瞧见没，那颗发财树就是我送给瑶瑶的，不贵，才三百多！”
三百多！
两桌的同学都忍不住看向周豪，眼中带着惊羡，有些同学忍不住看向自己花了几十块钱买的小礼物，悄悄低下头。
对于这些普通家庭的学生来说，三百多的贺礼，只有他们那些至亲长辈才能拿得出来。而同学之间，大部分都是花个几十块，买些小礼物，表示一下就算了。
周豪这份礼物，足以自傲！
感受到周围同学对自己投来羡慕嫉妒恨的目光，周豪脸上，更加得意，不经意间，扫了陈默一眼，眼中露出一抹挑衅。
蒋瑶倒是不在意礼物是否贵重，可人家既然送了，必须要表达谢意：“周豪，让你破费了！”
听到蒋瑶感谢，周豪的虚荣心一下子爆棚，大手一挥，一脸得瑟：“小意思，等你过生日，我送你五百元的礼物！”
五百元的生日礼物，在郑元昊和安可悦那些富二代的小团体中，说出去只会让人嗤笑，可在这些普通学生的小团体内，已经是不得了的大礼。
一些女生，看向周豪的眼神，都快要冒出小星星了。
也有些男生暗暗不忿，他们看不惯周豪故意在蒋瑶面前显摆，可家庭条件摆在那，他们无法跟周豪攀比，只能忍气吞声。
虽然都是普通家庭，可普通家庭也分三六九等，也会有攀比之心，周豪的家庭，在这个圈子里，明显属于顶尖的。
content_en:
Chapter 015 Tit for tat
Chen Mo smiled at Jiang Yao's mother and cupped her hands: "I wish Auntie a prosperous business and lots of money!"
Jiang Yao's parents are both honest and sincere people. After hearing Chen Mo's congratulatory message, Jiang Yao's mother suddenly smiled and looked at Chen Mo with her eyes shining: "Xiao Mo is really good at talking. No wonder my Yaoyao talks about it all day long. It's not bad. It seems that this kid Yaoyao is very discerning!"
Jiang Yao stamped her feet anxiously at the side. She, who was already extremely low on self-esteem, blushed to the very root of her neck. In front of so many classmates, her mother teased her like this. How could she still have the face to see others when she went to school?
"Mom, go and get busy, go quickly, my classmates are all impatient!"
With that said, Jiang Yao pushed her mother into the kitchen.
Chen Mo wanted to finish his congratulations and send the red envelope, but Jiang Yao's mother was kicked away by Jiang Yao. Now Chen Mo didn't know what to do.
If it were given to Jiang Yao, this little girl would definitely not accept it, so Chen Mo quietly dropped the red envelope on the table at the cashier while no one was paying attention, and then stood there as if nothing had happened.
Jiang Yao pushed her mother away, then turned around, glanced at Chen Mo sheepishly, pointed to the two large round tables that were not yet full and said: "Chen Mo, they are all classmates in our class, which table do you want to sit at?"
"Chen Mo, sit here!" Zhao Gang, the fat man who reminded Chen Mo in the examination room that day, shouted enthusiastically.
"Okay!" Chen Mo walked over with a smile, sat down and started chatting with a few classmates who were close friends in his previous life.
Seeing Chen Mo take his seat, Jiang Yao felt relieved, smiled at her classmates and said, "Let's chat first, I'll go see if the food is ready?"
"Yao Yao, stop working so hard. We are all classmates. Why are you so polite? Find a seat and sit down quickly. Everyone is waiting to talk to you!" A boy shouted to Jiang Yao, which immediately attracted the attention of most of the classmates.
Chen Mo looked over. He remembered this boy, Wang Lei, who had great organizational skills and was a representative figure among ordinary students in high school.
"That's right, Yaoyao, please sit down quickly. We won't be able to chat without you!" A girl with acne on her face pulled Jiang Yao and said.
Other students also booed and asked Jiang Yao to sit down.
Chen Mo didn't speak, but looked at Jiang Yao with a smile, hoping that she could sit down and chat with everyone. After all, she was the initiator of this gathering.
Seeing everyone's strong invitation, Jiang Yao had no choice but to agree: "Okay, then I will sit down and talk with you."
There were two tables at the scene, and each table had two or three empty seats. Everyone was clamoring to invite Jiang Yao to their table.
Jiang Yao's eyes swept between the two tables and lingered on Chen Mo for a moment.
Zhao Gang, who was attentive next to Chen Mo, caught it immediately, curled his lips, and hurriedly stood up and said: "Yao Yao, you can sit here with me. This seat is in the middle. It happens that the students at both tables can be accommodated. I can just sit in the empty seat in front."
After saying that, he raised his eyebrows at Chen Mo, looking like "You owe your brother a favor."
Chen Mo laughed dumbly and shook his head helplessly. He could only accept Zhao Gang's kindness.
The other boys who also wanted to invite Jiang Yao suddenly turned ugly and secretly scolded Zhao Gang for being naughty, but the excuses they gave were so high-sounding that they could not refute them.
Jiang Yao wanted to sit with Chen Mo, but she couldn't say it clearly. When she saw Zhao Gang giving up his seat and finding such a good reason, she was naturally very happy: "Okay, thank you Zhao Gang!"
Seeing Jiang Yao sitting next to Chen Mo and still leaning so close, some boys who had thoughts about Jiang Yao suddenly became unhappy.
The two boys looked at each other secretly, nodded slightly, and then one of the boys pretended to be casual and asked: "By the way, Zhou Hao, today is the opening day of Jiang Yao's restaurant. What gifts have you prepared?"
Zhou Hao, who had his hair parted to the side, immediately puffed up his chest and pointed proudly at the pot of money tree at the door: "See, that money tree was given to Yaoyao by me. It's not expensive, only more than three hundred!"
More than three hundred!
The students at both tables couldn't help but look at Zhou Hao, with surprise and envy in their eyes. Some students couldn't help but look at the small gifts they had spent dozens of dollars to buy, and quietly lowered their heads.
For these students from ordinary families, only their closest relatives and elders can afford a gift of more than 300 yuan. Among classmates, most of them spend dozens of yuan to buy some small gifts as a token of appreciation.
Zhou Hao’s gift is enough to be proud of!
Feeling the envious, jealous and hateful glances of the surrounding classmates towards him, Zhou Hao's face became even more proud. Inadvertently, he glanced at Chen Mo with a hint of provocation in his eyes.
Jiang Yao didn't care whether the gift was expensive or not, but since it was given to her, she had to express her gratitude: "Zhou Hao, I spent a lot of money on you! "
Hearing Jiang Yao's thanks, Zhou Hao's vanity suddenly exploded. He waved his hand and said with a proud look on his face: "I don't care, when it's your birthday, I'll give you a gift of five hundred yuan! "
A five-hundred-yuan birthday gift would only make people laugh in a small group of rich second-generation people like Zheng Yuanhao and An Keyue, but in a small group of ordinary students, it was already an incredible gift.
Some girls looked at Zhou Hao with eyes that were about to have little stars popping out.
There are also some boys who are secretly unhappy. They can't stand Zhou Hao deliberately showing off in front of Jiang Yao, but due to their family conditions, they can't compare with Zhou Hao and can only swallow their anger.
Although they are all ordinary families, ordinary families are also divided into three, six or nine levels, and they will also have a desire to compare. Zhou Hao's family is obviously top-notch in this circle.
